welcome.title: Welcome to ClimaBalance
welcome.description: A climate mitigation platform dedicated to supporting local reforestation. We connect emission compensation to a multifaceted network of initiatives, encompassing native forest restoration, agroforestry systems, and agroecology.
welcome.transferNotice: Contribution amounts are transferred to the reforester responsible for the area, with a fee charged for platform maintenance and evolution.
welcome.step1Description: Answer simple questions about your consumption to calculate your CO2 emissions.
welcome.step2Description: Direct support to audited initiatives in restoration, agroecology, and sustainable agricultural production.
welcome.step3Description: Receive certificates and track contributions with transparency and traceability.

hero.title: Climate technology connecting carbon, land, and real impact
hero.description: ClimaBalance is a climate impact platform created to connect people and companies with audited Agroecology, Agroforestry, Permaculture, Organic Agriculture, and other ecological farming initiatives.

whatIs.label: What it is
whatIs.title: A platform that turns climate intention into traceable action
whatIs.paragraph1: ClimaBalance was created to make carbon compensation clearer, more trustworthy, and more connected to the territory. It helps users understand emissions and direct support to audited projects that combine environmental restoration with ecological agricultural production.
whatIs.paragraph2: Instead of treating compensation as something abstract, the platform structures the process with an interactive map, socio-environmental criteria, contribution traceability, and validated impact certificates, prioritizing initiatives such as Agroecology, Agroforestry, Permaculture, and Organic Agriculture.
whatIs.paragraph3: When a contribution is made, the amount is transferred to the reforester responsible for the supported area, while the platform charges a fee to sustain ongoing maintenance and evolution.

partnerCall.label: Partnerships
partnerCall.title: We are looking for partners to keep building the project
partnerCall.description: The platform is under development, and we are looking for strategic, technical, and institutional partners to expand support for ecological farming, territorial restoration, and regenerative production projects.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: A simple flow with end-to-end transparency
howItWorks.description: The experience is designed to connect calculation, decision, and validation for people and organizations that want to offset emissions with more confidence.
howItWorks.step1Description: People and companies provide consumption and activity data to estimate emissions and understand their carbon footprint.
howItWorks.step2Description: Users explore audited areas and projects, compare initiative details, and choose where to direct their compensation.
howItWorks.step3Description: After compensation, the platform records the operation, transfers the amount to the reforester responsible for the area, charges a maintenance and evolution fee, and provides a certificate with validation mechanisms.

objectives.label: Objectives
objectives.title: What ClimaBalance is designed to enable
objectives.description: The project aims to combine decarbonization, operational trust, and direct support for initiatives that restore ecosystems and strengthen ecological agricultural production models.
objectives.card1Description: Make carbon footprint understanding easier and broaden access to concrete compensation actions.
objectives.card2Description: Direct resources to properties and initiatives evaluated with socio-environmental criteria, including Agroecology, Agroforestry, Permaculture, and Organic Agriculture.
objectives.card3Description: Strengthen trust through audit trails, certificates, evidence records, and transparency about where compensation goes.

methodology.label: Calculation Methodology
methodology.title: How calculations are made
methodology.paragraph: Carbon footprint calculations use emission factors based on technical references such as GHG Protocol, IPCC, and SEEG Brazil (2024). These values are technical approximations and do not represent a formally certified or regulated methodology by any official body. Results are estimates for awareness and reference purposes, not a substitute for formal emissions inventories.

why.title: Why do we use Stripe?
why.security: Stripe is one of the world's most secure payment platforms, certified PCI DSS Level 1 — the highest security standard in the industry. All financial data is encrypted and Stripe manages all regulatory compliance, protecting you and your supporters.
why.ease: With Stripe, you don't need to worry about payment infrastructure. The integration is simple and fast: you connect your account, and everything else — payment splitting, transfers, reporting — is automated by the platform.

fees.title: Transaction fees
fees.desc: Stripe charges a fee per transaction (usually a percentage + fixed amount). This fee is automatically deducted at the time of contribution and covers processing, fraud prevention, and support.
fees.note: In addition to Stripe's fee, the platform applies an administrative fee, which is transparently disclosed before each operation.

step1.title: Connect your account or create from scratch
step1.desc: In your reforester profile, go to the payments section and click "Connect to Stripe". If you don't have a Stripe account yet, the integration form will guide you through creation. Have your CPF/CNPJ, bank account, and email ready.

step2.title: Fill in your details on Stripe
step2.desc: You'll be redirected to Stripe's secure environment. Enter your personal or business details, address, and bank account. Stripe uses this information to verify your identity and enable payments.

step3.title: Wait for verification
step3.desc: Stripe reviews the submitted information and documents. In most cases verification is completed within minutes. You'll receive confirmation automatically.

step4.title: Done!
step4.desc: With your account verified, you can now receive transfers from supporter contributions. Amounts are automatically forwarded by the platform.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: This policy explains what information ClimaBalance may store, how it is used, how long it may be retained, and what rights you can exercise over your data.
hero.effectiveDate: This policy may be updated as the project evolves.

summary.label: Summary
summary.title: We process personal data only to operate the platform with transparency, security, and traceability.
summary.paragraph1: ClimaBalance may store account, profile, footprint calculations, compensations, certificates, uploaded media, and technical records needed for authentication, security, audit, and fraud prevention.
summary.paragraph2: Our commitment is to collect only what is necessary for the service to work, protect that information, and respect requests for deletion, anonymization, and revocation whenever this is technically and legally possible.

dataCollected.title: What information may be stored
dataCollected.paragraph1: We may store registration data such as email, protected password, language, user profile, optional identification information, and contact data. We may also store information you provide in your profile, including display name, document number, phone number, birth date, and address.
dataCollected.paragraph2: We may also store operational data such as footprint calculations, reported emissions, selected areas or projects, compensations, issued certificates, uploaded media, login records, session tokens, audit logs, and IP addresses used for security.

howUsed.title: How this information is used
howUsed.paragraph1: We use this information to create and maintain your account, authenticate access, enable platform features, calculate carbon footprint, record compensations, issue certificates, display activity history, and support the general operation of the service.
howUsed.paragraph2: Data may also be used for security, abuse prevention, incident response, operational traceability, flow auditing, and technical product improvement.

sharing.title: Data sharing and exposure
sharing.paragraph1: ClimaBalance is not intended to sell personal data. Some information may be displayed inside the platform when it is part of the product flow, such as public name, linked projects, certificates, and records needed to prove contributions.
sharing.paragraph2: We may also share data with technical providers strictly required for hosting, storage, email, security, or payment operations, always within what is necessary to provide the service.

security.title: Security and protection
security.paragraph1: We adopt reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect stored data. This includes authentication, access control, audit records, password protection, and security mechanisms to reduce automated abuse and unauthorized access.
security.paragraph2: Even with protective efforts, no internet-connected system can guarantee zero risk. Because of that, we monitor relevant events and may adjust security controls whenever necessary.

deletion.title: Account deletion, right to be forgotten, and retention
deletion.paragraph1: You may request deletion of your account and the personal data linked to it. When applicable, that data will be removed, anonymized, or made inaccessible, depending on the nature of the information and the technical and legal limitations of the service.
deletion.paragraph2: Some records may need to be retained for longer in order to comply with legal obligations, security, fraud prevention, certificate integrity, transaction proof, or audit consistency. In those cases, we retain only what is strictly necessary.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.paragraph1: You may request access, correction, update or deletion of personal information provided to ClimaBalance, as well as withdraw consent when processing depends on it.
rights.paragraph2: Privacy and data requests can be handled through the support and contact channels made available by the project. In some cases, we may request additional identity verification before executing the request.

legalBases.title: Legal bases for processing
legalBases.paragraph1: ClimaBalance processes personal data based on the following legal grounds, in accordance with the LGPD and GDPR:
legalBases.item1: Consent: for account creation, cookie acceptance and optional communications.
legalBases.item2: Contract performance: to operate the platform, process compensations and issue certificates.
legalBases.item3: Legal obligation: to comply with tax, accounting and regulatory requirements.
legalBases.item4: Legitimate interest: for security, fraud prevention, audit and service improvement.
legalBases.paragraph2: Consent may be withdrawn at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to withdrawal.

dataRetention.title: Data retention periods
dataRetention.paragraph1: We keep your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected:
dataRetention.item1: Account data: retained while the account is active. After deletion, soft-delete for up to 90 days, then anonymization or permanent deletion.
dataRetention.item2: Compensation and certificate data: retained for up to 5 years after the last transaction to meet tax and regulatory obligations.
dataRetention.item3: Audit records: retained for up to 3 years.
dataRetention.item4: Session and refresh tokens: retained until expiration or revocation, whichever occurs first.
dataRetention.item5: Payment data: processed exclusively by Stripe. ClimaBalance does not store full credit card details.
dataRetention.paragraph2: After the retention period, data is anonymized or permanently deleted.

dpo.title: Data Protection Officer (DPO)
dpo.paragraph1: For privacy and data protection matters, please contact our Data Protection Officer:
dpo.paragraph2: The DPO handles data subject rights requests, questions about data processing and guidance on this policy.

internationalTransfer.title: International data transfer
internationalTransfer.paragraph1: ClimaBalance uses third-party services that may involve data transfer outside Brazil and the European Union, including:
internationalTransfer.item1: Stripe (USA): payment processing. Stripe is Privacy Shield certified and uses Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for GDPR compliance.
internationalTransfer.item2: Cloud hosting and infrastructure providers: may involve servers located in different countries.
internationalTransfer.item3: Transactional email services: for sending notifications and confirmations.
internationalTransfer.paragraph2: In such cases, we adopt contractual and technical mechanisms to ensure your data receives the same level of protection required by applicable law.

rightsProcedures.title: How to exercise your rights
rightsProcedures.paragraph1: You may exercise your data subject rights at any time through the following channels:
rightsProcedures.item1: Directly on the platform: access your profile to edit, correct or update your personal data.
rightsProcedures.item2: Formal request: use the subject request form available on the platform (Privacy menu).
rightsProcedures.item3: Contact the DPO: send an email to dpo@climabalance.org.
rightsProcedures.paragraph2: We will respond to your request within 15 days, as provided by the LGPD. In complex cases, the deadline may be extended with justification.

hero.title: Terms of Use
hero.description: By using ClimaBalance, you agree to these Terms of Use. Please read them carefully before continuing.

summary.label: Summary
summary.title: These terms govern the use of the ClimaBalance platform.
summary.paragraph: ClimaBalance is a technology platform that connects Users (who wish to calculate and offset their carbon footprint) with Partners/Collaborators (independent individuals or entities responsible for the actual planting and maintenance of trees). ClimaBalance acts strictly as an intermediary technology provider and payment processor facilitator; it does not directly own the offset lands or perform the physical planting. All carbon capture projections are estimates based on scientific models.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using ClimaBalance, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree to these terms, do not use the platform.

services.title: 2. Service Description and Platform Role
services.body: ClimaBalance provides a digital ecosystem for carbon footprint calculation, connection to localized regeneration projects, and digital certificate issuance. The Intermediation Model: You acknowledge that ClimaBalance does not directly provide tree planting services. The platform connects you with independent Partners/Collaborators who execute the regeneration work. Estimates: Values, carbon capture metrics, and environmental projections displayed on the platform are estimates based on scientific data and do not constitute a strict guarantee of specific physical or commercial results.

account.title: 3. User & Partner Accounts
account.body: Account Responsibility: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account. You agree to provide true, accurate, and up-to-date information. Independent Partners (Collaborators): If you register as a Partner/Collaborator to receive funds for land regeneration, you expressly declare that no employment relationship, joint venture, or subordination exists between you and ClimaBalance. You operate with total technical and schedule autonomy. Suspension: ClimaBalance reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, engage in fraud, or provide false identification (including invalid Tax IDs/CPFs).

payments.title: 4. Payments, Split Fees, and Taxation
payments.body: Payment Processing: All transactions are processed securely via Stripe. The Split Mechanism: When a User pays for an offset, Stripe automatically splits the funds: a technology and facilitation fee (the platform percentage) is directed to ClimaBalance, and the remaining balance (the direct regeneration fund) is transferred directly to the designated independent Partner's connected account. Taxation & Invoicing (International & Domestic): ClimaBalance will issue a formal Invoice/Nota Fiscal solely for its technology intermediation percentage (the fee retained by the platform). For the remaining portion of the payment transferred to the Partner, the platform will automatically generate a digital Receipt/Invoice on behalf of the Partner to the User. Partners (individuals/CPFs) are solely responsible for declaring their respective earnings to their local tax authorities (such as Carnê-Leão/Imposto de Renda in Brazil). Refunds & Chargebacks: Refunds follow the specific policy of the chosen project. In the event of a credit card dispute or chargeback initiated by a User due to a Partner's failure to deliver or prove the planting, ClimaBalance reserves the right to withhold future payouts from that specific Partner to cover the processing losses.

content.title: 5. Content and Intellectual Property
content.body: All platform infrastructure, algorithms, carbon calculators, logos, and software are the exclusive property of ClimaBalance or its licensors. Partners grant ClimaBalance a worldwide, royalty-free license to display project photos, coordinates, and updates within the platform for transparency and verification purposes.

liability.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: ClimaBalance acts as a technology intermediary and shall not be held liable for: Any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from platform usage. Natural disasters, climate anomalies, or force majeure events that may affect the physical survival of the trees planted by Partners. Temporary platform instability or server downtimes. Liability Cap: In any event, ClimaBalance's total liability to any user or partner shall be strictly limited to the amount of intermediation fees retained by the platform from that specific user's transactions during the preceding three (3) months.

termination.title: 7. Termination
termination.body: Users and Partners may terminate their accounts at any time through the app or by written request. ClimaBalance may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms immediately upon notice.

governingLaw.title: 8. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
governingLaw.body: These Terms of Use are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil. Any legal disputes, claims, or proceedings arising out of or in connection with these terms shall be brought exclusively before the courts of Brasília, DF, Brazil, regardless of the user's or partner's country of residence.

changes.title: 9. Changes to Terms
changes.body: These terms may be updated periodically to reflect new features or legal requirements. Material changes will be communicated via email or in-app notification.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.body: Questions regarding these terms? Please contact us at: termos@climabalance.com

producer.stripe.not_connected: You haven't connected your Stripe account yet.
producer.stripe.connect_not_enabled: Your Stripe dashboard does not have Connect enabled yet. Enable Stripe Connect on the platform account and try again.

producer.stripe.onboarding_title: How to connect your Stripe account
producer.stripe.what_is_desc: Stripe Connect allows you to receive payments for carbon offsets on your registered areas.
producer.stripe.prerequisites_desc: You need: a bank account, identity document (CPF or CNPJ), and a valid email address.
producer.stripe.step1_desc: Click the Connect to Stripe button to be redirected to the registration form.
producer.stripe.step2_desc: Enter your personal information, address, and banking details in the Stripe form.
producer.stripe.step3_desc: Stripe will verify your identity using the documents you provide.
producer.stripe.step4_desc: Once approved, you can start receiving payments for your offset areas.
producer.stripe.faq_a1: No. Individuals (CPF) can also register with Stripe.
producer.stripe.faq_q2: How long until the money arrives?
producer.stripe.faq_a2: Stripe processes automatic transfers every 30 days.
producer.stripe.faq_a3: The platform retains 5% of each compensation amount for maintenance and evolution.
platform.stripe.title: Stripe Platform Setup
platform.stripe.short_desc: Operational checklist to configure Stripe Connect, webhook, and payment split for the platform.
platform.stripe.step1: 1. Enable Stripe Connect on the platform account and complete the Platform Profile.
platform.stripe.step2: 2. Configure STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, and STRIPE_PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT in the backend.
platform.stripe.step3: 3. Configure VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY in the frontend to enable Stripe.js at checkout.
platform.stripe.step4: 4. Create webhook endpoint at /api/v1/payments/webhook and subscribe to payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed, and account.updated.
platform.stripe.step5: 5. Validate payment split in Stripe dashboard (5% platform, remaining connected reforester).
platform.stripe.step6: 6. Monitor webhook signature errors and duplicate events to ensure reliability.
platform.stripe.docs_desc: Follow the complete webhook and environment validation guide in the document below.

dashboard.totalFootprint: Sum of calculated emissions across the available records for this user.
dashboard.compensated: Volume of emissions already compensated in paid and confirmed records.
dashboard.balance: Difference between the estimated total emissions and what has already been compensated.
dashboard.treesPlanted: Total number of trees linked to confirmed compensations.

home.inDevelopmentAria: Help about the project development status
home.inDevelopment: This POC is still evolving. Some features may change, and the project is looking for partners to continue development.

shared.tco2e: tCO2e means tonnes of CO2 equivalent, a metric that combines different greenhouse gases into one comparable unit.
shared.tco2ePerTreeAria: Help about tCO2e per tree per year
shared.tco2ePerTree: This value estimates how much carbon a tree associated with the project may contribute per year. It is a projection reference, not an isolated guarantee per unit.

footprint.dataQuality: Choose the level that best matches the quality of the information used in the calculation. Real data usually leads to more reliable estimates.
footprint.profileType: Use Individual for personal calculations and Legal Entity for emissions related to a company or organization.
footprint.period: The result only considers the selected time range. Ideally, use a period that is representative of the consumption being analyzed.
footprint.scope1: Scope 1 includes direct emissions under your control, such as combustion, process emissions, and fugitive leaks.
footprint.scope2: Scope 2 covers emissions linked to purchased energy, such as electricity, steam, or heat.
footprint.scope3: Scope 3 groups indirect emissions across the value chain, such as travel, commuting, purchased goods, and waste.
footprint.statusDraft: Draft calculations can still be edited before finalization.
footprint.statusFinalized: Finalized means the calculation is complete and ready to be used for reporting and compensation.
footprint.totalEmissions: This is the estimated total emissions for the selected period based on the data you entered.
footprint.compensate: You can use this result to direct support to ecological projects and compensate the estimated emissions.

units.kwh: kWh is the unit used for electricity consumption.
units.km: Enter the distance traveled in km.
units.liter: Enter the consumed volume in liters.

footprint.comparison: Compares your total emissions to the Brazilian average (~2.0 tCO₂e/year per capita) and the global average (~4.0 tCO₂e/year per capita).
footprint.stationaryCombustion: Stationary combustion includes fuel burned in fixed equipment like generators, boilers, furnaces, and heaters on your premises.
footprint.mobileCombustion: Mobile combustion covers fuel burned by vehicles owned or controlled by the company, such as delivery trucks, service vans, and company cars.
footprint.fugitiveEmissions: Fugitive emissions are intentional or unintentional releases of gases from equipment like refrigeration systems, air conditioning, and gas pipelines.
footprint.processEmissions: Process emissions are released during industrial or chemical processes, such as cement production, chemical manufacturing, or metallurgy.
footprint.domesticEconomy: Domestic flights in economy class. Economy class has lower emissions per passenger due to higher seat density.
footprint.domesticBusiness: Domestic flights in business class. Business class has higher emissions per passenger due to larger seat footprint.
footprint.internationalEconomy: International flights in economy class. Economy class has lower emissions per passenger due to higher seat density.
footprint.internationalBusiness: International flights in business class. Business class has higher emissions per passenger due to larger seat footprint.
footprint.kgCO2e: kgCO₂e is the same measurement as tCO₂e but in kilograms (1 tCO₂e = 1,000 kgCO₂e).
footprint.kwhHelper: You can find your monthly kWh consumption on your electricity bill, under 'Consumo kWh' or 'Current Reading'.

compensation.treePurchase: Best for supporting ecological projects through tree-linked planting and long-term land stewardship.
compensation.directTco2e: Best for entering the amount of emissions you want to offset directly in tCO2e.
compensation.paymentStatus: The payment status shows whether the financial operation was completed, is pending, or failed.

checkout.mode: Shows how this compensation was structured: by tree purchase or by direct tCO2e volume.
checkout.trees: Number of trees or equivalent units linked to this compensation.
checkout.total: Estimated total financial amount for this operation.
checkout.installments: Number of installments used in the payment simulation.
checkout.testCard: This flow uses a simulated payment for POC demonstration purposes.
checkout.simulationStatus: Indicates whether this transaction was a real payment or a simulation/test used during development or demonstration.

area.statusSummary: The status shows which stage the area is in, from initial registration to approval, activation, rejection, or suspension.
area.location: The coordinates help identify the area on the map and connect evidence, audit, and territorial context.
area.biome: The biome helps contextualize the area environmentally and may influence evaluation criteria and project communication.
area.totalCapacity: Estimated total compensation capacity that the area can support over the lifetime of the project.
area.committed: Part of the total capacity that has already been reserved or linked to compensations.
area.available: Portion of the capacity still available for new support and compensation operations.
area.usage: Percentage of the area's total capacity that is already committed.
area.pricePerTree: Use this USD amount when support is modeled by number of trees or equivalent project units.
area.defaultHorizonYearsAria: Help about the project's default horizon
area.defaultHorizonYears: Defines the default year horizon used as the reference for estimates and operations linked to this area.
area.pricePerTco2e: Use this value when compensation is offered directly by emissions volume in tCO2e.
area.treeSpecies: Describe the tree species you intend to plant in this area. This helps contextualize the project and provides transparency about planning.
area.externalLink: Add a link to an external page with more information about the project, such as website, portfolio, or social media.
area.maxPurchasableTrees: Maximum number of trees that can be purchased for this area. Leave empty to use the system default.
area.media: Media helps document the area, strengthen credibility, and support audit and transparency.
area.contributions: List of recorded contributions for this area, including compensated volume and associated tree count when applicable.
area.statusDraft: The area is still being edited and has not been submitted for audit yet.
area.statusPendingAudit: The area was submitted and is waiting for review before it can be approved.
area.statusApproved: The area passed review and is ready for operational activation.
area.statusActive: The area is available for support and compensation on the platform.
area.statusRejected: The area was rejected during audit and needs adjustments before it can be submitted again.
area.statusSuspended: The area was temporarily paused and should not receive new operations.
area.submitForAudit: Submitting for audit sends the area for review by an analyst. Once submitted, the area cannot be edited until the audit is completed.
area.suspend: Suspending the area makes it temporarily unavailable for new compensations. Existing contributions and planted trees are not affected.
area.treesPlanted: Trees Planted shows the physical trees already geo-tagged on the map. The number after the slash is the total trees funded through compensations already recorded for this area.
area.compensated: Estimated total CO2e already compensated through contributions to this area, based on the projected capture rate per tree.

certificates.validation: Validation checks whether the certificate number and hash match a record issued by the platform.
certificates.certificateNumber: Enter the certificate identifier exactly as it appears in the PDF or issuance record.
certificates.hash: The hash is an integrity identifier used to verify that the certificate matches the issued document.
certificates.status: The status indicates the current state of the certificate on the platform.

roles.individual: Individual Supporter: ideal for calculating and offsetting your personal carbon footprint, supporting projects, and tracking your impact.
roles.legal_entity: Legal Entity: for companies and organizations that want to manage institutional emissions, support projects, and receive certificates.
roles.producer: Reforester: can register and manage areas, receive compensation transfers, and track supporter contributions.
roles.analyst: Analyst: reviews and audits area registrations, evaluates socio-environmental criteria, and approves or rejects submissions.
roles.administrator: Administrator: full access to manage users, areas, audit logs, and platform configuration.

certificate.issued: Issued: the certificate has been generated and is valid for verification.
certificate.revoked: Revoked: the certificate has been invalidated and should not be used for verification purposes.

payment.pending: The payment is being processed. It may take a few moments to confirm.
payment.paid: The payment was completed successfully and the compensation is recorded.
payment.failed: The payment failed. You may need to try again with a different payment method.
payment.canceled: The compensation was canceled before payment was completed.
payment.refunded: The amount has been returned to the supporter.

user.active: Active: the account is fully operational with complete platform access.
user.inactive: Inactive: the account was deactivated by the user or the system.
user.suspended: Suspended: the account has been temporarily restricted by an administrator.

review.remainingTrees: Number currently available for new contributions in this area. The limit considers the planned total minus what has already been committed.
review.pricePerTree: Unit price defined for this area. It is used to calculate this contribution and may reflect planting, maintenance, and project monitoring costs.
review.estimatedCO2: Estimated CO2e associated with the selected quantity, using the per-tree rate and the project's default time horizon. It is a projection for reference, not an individual guarantee.
review.treesCount: Enter how many trees you want to support in this contribution. The total amount and estimated CO2e update automatically.

treePlanting.manualMode: Manual Mode: click on the map to place each tree individually, one by one.
treePlanting.areaMode: Area Mode: hold Shift and drag to draw a rectangle; trees will be automatically distributed within the selected area.

payment.pix: PIX is an instant payment system from the Brazilian Central Bank. Scan this QR Code with your bank's app to pay. Confirmation happens within seconds.
payment.pixCopyPaste: If your banking app does not support QR code scanning, copy this code and paste it into the PIX payment area of your bank's app.

producer.chargesEnabled: Indicates whether your Stripe account can receive payments from contributions. Needs to be enabled for supporters to compensate in your areas.
producer.payoutsEnabled: Indicates whether funds can be automatically transferred to your bank account. Both must be enabled to receive contributions.
producer.pendingVerification: Stripe is verifying your identity and documents. This usually takes a few minutes. You will receive confirmation when complete.

profile.sessions: Active sessions show where your account is currently logged in. You can revoke individual sessions or all at once to force logout on other devices.

satellite.data: Satellite imagery is fetched periodically. The capture date shows when the image was taken, and cloud cover indicates visibility. A fallback image is used when cloud-free imagery is unavailable.

cookieConsent.message: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience, analyze usage, and personalize content. By continuing to browse, you agree to our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink> and <termsLink>Terms of Use</termsLink>.
